Sterilize each endoscope individually secured in a sterilization container. Only endoscopes marked “autoclave” can be autoclaved: clean thoroughly, then steam sterilize at 134°C for 5–8 minutes. Keep the container closed until cooled to room temperature; never immerse in cold water. Endoscopes not marked “autoclave” must not exceed 60°C; use sterilizing chemical solutions according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
